description_en: Adds a shared folder to the network disk
description_zh: 在网盘内新增共享的文件夹
kebab_example: aliyun ecd add-file-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --end-user-id alice --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3522820000 --file-id 6333e553a133ce21e6f747cf948bb9ef95d70000 --member-list '[{"DisinheritSubGroup":false,"CdsIdentity":{"Type":"IT_User","Id":"alice"},"ExpireTime":4775500800000,"RoleId":"SystemFileUploaderAndDownloader"}]' --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFilePermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who uses the network disk
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.name: cds_id

element_fields.help_en:
You can set permissions by specifying roles or by customizing operation permissions. This field is used to set permissions by specifying roles. This field is mutually exclusive with `ActionList`.

Valid values:

*   SystemFileEditorWithoutShareLink: The role that can edit but cannot share files.
*   SystemFileUploaderAndDownloaderWithShareLink: The role that can upload, download, and share files.
*   SystemFileDownloader: The role that can download files.
*   SystemFileEditorWithoutDelete: The role that can edit but cannot edit files.
*   SystemFileOwner: The role that can collaborate with others on files.
*   SystemFileDownloaderWithShareLink: The role that can download and share files.
*   SystemFileUploaderAndViewer: The role that can preview and upload files.
*   SystemFileViewer: The role that can preview files.
*   SystemFileEditor: The role that can edit files.
*   SystemFileUploaderWithShareLink: The role that can upload and share files.
*   SystemFileUploader: The role that can upload files.
*   SystemFileUploaderAndDownloader: The role that can upload and download files.
*   SystemFileMetaViewer: The role that can view file list
element_fields.help_zh: 目前支持两种方式设置权限，一种是通过指定角色设置权限，另一种是自定义设置操作权限，该字段用于指定角色设置权限，与`ActionList`互斥，当两个字段同时设置时，以该字段为准
element_fields.name: role_id

element_fields.help_en: The time when the authorization expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. The value never expires. You can specify a value that is predefined by the system for this parameter. Example: 4775500800000
element_fields.help_zh: 授权过期的时间。 从1970年1月1日0点到目标时间，单位：毫秒。 永久有效可以设置为系统预定义的一个值。例如：4775500800000
element_fields.name: expire_time

element_fields.help_en: Specifies whether the users of the child group can inherit the folder permissions
